## LangChain

> The most widely used framework for composing LLM applications: chains, retrievers, agents and tools.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `langchain-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/langchain'` |
| Maturité | beta |
| Niveau de preuve | **E2** — plus real execution against production, proof committed |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `langchain-core` 1.8.5 (bornes 1.0 → <2.0) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.5.0** |
| Tests hors ligne | 54 |
| Observations réelles | 6, dont 6 relues persistées |
| Facturée | oui |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** LangChain keeps orchestration, prompting, retrieval and whatever tracing stack you already run.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of each LLM interaction -- five signals with explicit provenance and an explicit measured / not-measured state -- without writing a measurement call per call site.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- The provider reports no token count, so nothing is submitted and nothing is estimated.
- Your own LLM call failed, so there is no complete interaction to measure.
- The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your chain is untouched.
- Sampling excluded the run, so no socket opens and nothing is billed.

🔴 Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. sample_rate defaults to 1.0, so read the cost section before pointing this at a busy application.

## Langfuse

> An open-source LLM observability platform: traces, prompts, cost, sessions, datasets and evaluation scores, self-hosted or in the cloud.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `langfuse-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/langfuse'` |
| Maturité | experimental |
| Niveau de preuve | **E1** — offline tests, green across platforms |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `langfuse` 5.2.0 (bornes 5.2.0 → <6.0) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.3.1 (captured fixture, not a live call)** |
| Tests hors ligne | 33 |
| Observations réelles | 0, dont 0 relues persistées |
| Facturée | non |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** Langfuse keeps the trace: prompt, completion, latency, cost, sessions, datasets, experiments, and the UI the developer already has open.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of the same interaction, written onto that Langfuse trace as scores -- one per signal the server declared measured -- with the NeoMundi request_id attached so the trace links to the signed record.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** Langfuse, langchain-neomundi.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- A signal the server did not declare measured gets no numeric score, not even its conventional value.
- There is no Langfuse trace to attach to, so nothing is written.
- A measurement that was not submitted writes only a summary saying so, never a signal.
- A Langfuse or bridge failure is reported as an outcome and never reaches your application.

🔴 The bridge never contacts NeoMundi and bills nothing by itself. The measurement it transports was billed when it was submitted, at 0.030 CHF per observation, by whatever produced it.

## LiteLLM

> An LLM gateway: one OpenAI-style API to 100+ providers, as a Python library or as a proxy server, with routing, retries, budgets and logging callbacks.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `litellm-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/litellm'` |
| Maturité | experimental |
| Niveau de preuve | **E1** — offline tests, green across platforms |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `litellm` 1.111.0 (bornes 1.111.0 → <2.0) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.3.1 (captured fixture, not a live call)** |
| Tests hors ligne | 47 |
| Observations réelles | 0, dont 0 relues persistées |
| Facturée | oui |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** LiteLLM keeps routing, retries, fallbacks, budgets, virtual keys, its cost table and whatever logging callbacks you already run.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of every chat completion the gateway routes, to any provider, from one attachment point -- with the latency LiteLLM observed, and only token counts the provider itself published.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** LiteLLM logging callbacks, Langfuse, langchain-neomundi.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- The provider published no token count; LiteLLM's zero or estimate is refused, never forwarded.
- An async stream hides the provider's payload from the logger, so it is refused rather than trusted.
- A cache hit, a failed call or a non-chat call is not a model interaction to measure.
- The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your call is untouched.

🔴 Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. sample_rate defaults to 1.0 and a gateway sees every call -- start with submit=False, which needs no key and opens no socket.
